mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 0.3 percentage points in three months signals tight labor markets, boosting corporate earnings growth and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p >0.05) or UNRATE does not exceed 0.3pp threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of falling FEDFUNDS rates below 2% and rising GDPC1 demand growth above 5% in the prior month signals accommodative monetary policy and robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS <2% and GDPC1 growth >5% in prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline when both proxies meet the trigger condition (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, simultaneous rises in INDPRO (supply) and HOUST (demand) indicate strong economic momentum, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in >60% of instances during late-cycle expansion despite the signal, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDPC1 demand growth signals robust economic activity, enhancing corporate profits and consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive when GDPC1 is rising (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly GDPC1 growth exceeding 5% in the prior month indicates strong demand expansion, fostering optimism about corporate earnings and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline when GDPC1 growth crosses the 5% threshold (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in FEDFUNDS below 1% signals highly accommodative monetary policy, rapidly lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive within 5 days when FEDFUNDS drops below 1% (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, simultaneous rises in FEDFUNDS rates and declines in INDPRO (supply) signal contractionary policy and weak demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in >60% of instances during tightening cycles despite the signal, or Rank IC >0.03 over any 3-year window.
